I guess this is not what we intended to test. Holding after UpdatePod has to work.
I am trying to find what's wrong with this.

Maybe we should have added drainAllWorkers before the second UpdatePod, so that the second UpdatePod does not set 5-static terminating (at https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/2b3508e0f10ac3c2c2cc0818ea081261c1256cfe/pkg/kubelet/pod_workers.go#L633-L642) 
before the pod worker of 5-static starts the work passed by the first UpdatePod.

or Channel(uid).Hold() should drain all works of the pod worker of the uid.

@smarterclayton 
What do you think?
